title: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 10.5 Polar Form of Complex Numbers: Plot complex numbers in the complex plane.
summary: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 10.5 Polar Form of Complex Numbers: Plot complex numbers in the complex plane.
body: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, section "10.5 Polar Form of Complex Numbers", prints these objectives: "Plot complex numbers in the complex plane." "Find the absolute value of a complex number." "Write complex numbers in polar form." "Convert a complex number from polar to rectangular form." "Find products of complex numbers in polar form." "Find quotients of complex numbers in polar form.". The section text says: "“God made the integers; all else is the work of man.” This rather famous quote by nineteenth-century German mathematician Leopold Kronecker sets the stage for this section on the polar form of a complex number. Complex numbers were invented by people and represent over a thousand years of continuous investigation and struggle by mathematicians such as Pythagoras , Descartes , De Moivre, Euler , Gauss , and others. Complex numbers answered questions that for centuries had puzzled the greatest…" This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
